title: 第11章 葫芦娃？（别养啊！求追读啊！）
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你在画什么？”

自从考试那天吼了那一嗓子之后，坐在他旁边的班长经常盯着贺舟看。

只是盯着看，也不说话，把他弄得心底毛毛的。

“画漫画。”

“噢，什么漫画？”

“……”

贺舟盯着自己画的封面上的三个【葫芦娃】的字沉默了一会，还是解释了一下：“就是一根藤上结出七个娃，最后他们化为了一座山镇压了妖怪打败了妖怪的故事！”

“主打的就是一个…”

团结两个字还没说出来，只见那边的班长长叹了口气：“是啊，他们失去了自由，失去了未来，变成了一座坟，还要七个人共享一座坟……何其可悲。”

“啊？”

贺舟完全茫然，被他们的脑回路震惊，无话可说，所有的情绪都化为了一个‘啊’字。

七个人共享一座坟？

这就是你们致郁谜语人的视角对葫芦娃的解读吗？

谁特么教的你们这样的脑回路？

这是活人该有的脑回路吗？

你们的热血呢！

他寻思着再去找别人问一下。

扭头看向了旁边一脸忧郁的路安，还没开口，他就说话了。

“我懂你想表达的，不过最终七个人，一座荒凉孤坟。”

“那是山！！！！”

“是啊，镇压着人灵魂的山，也是囚牢。”

“……”

力竭了。

看到贺舟久久没说话，那边路安看向他：“难道不是吗？”

“……”

“你为什么不说话。”

“我去画坟了！”

贺舟放弃交流，正打算继续肝漫画的时候，旁边的江黛趴在桌上，像小猫一样探头，好奇地盯着葫芦娃。

“它们关系真好，都不会抢吃的耶！”

贺舟生无可恋：“是啊，他们不仅不会抢吃的，还不会抢猫砂盆。”

江黛眨了眨眼，晃了晃脑袋，在旁边盯着看漫画。

终于，在贺舟拿笔开始准备画的时候，就看到了从天而降的评论。

【噗，七个人一座坟？这漫画里有正常人吗？】

【太阴间了，我要是来这我呆不了三天我就得疯。】

【保守了，一天。】

"What are you drawing?"

Ever since he yelled that way on the exam day, the monitor sitting next to him often stared at He Zhou.

He just stared and didn't say anything, which made him feel very nervous.

"Draw comics."

"Oh, what comics?"

"..."

He Zhou stared at the three words "Calabash Baby" on the cover of his painting and was silent for a while, then explained: "It's the story of seven babies born on a vine, and finally they turned into a mountain to suppress the monster and defeat the monster!"

"The main thing is one..."

Before the word unity could be uttered, the monitor over there sighed: "Yes, they have lost their freedom and their future. They have become a grave, and seven people have to share the same grave... How sad."

"Huh?"

He Zhou was completely at a loss. He was shocked by their brain circuits and had nothing to say. All his emotions were reduced to the word 'ah'.

Seven people sharing one grave?

Is this how you, the Depressed Riddler, interpret Calabash Baby?

Who taught you such a brain circuit?

Is this the brain circuit that a living person should have?

Where is your passion!

He thought about asking someone else.

He turned to look at the melancholy-looking Lu An next to him. Before he could speak, he spoke.

"I understand what you want to express, but in the end, seven people, a desolate and lonely tomb."

“THAT’S A MOUNTAIN!!!”

"Yes, the mountain that suppresses the human soul is also a prison."

"..."

Exhausted.

Seeing that He Zhou didn't speak for a long time, Lu An looked at him: "Isn't it?"

"..."

"Why don't you speak."

"I'm going to paint the grave!"

When He Zhou gave up the communication and was about to continue the liver comics, Jiang Dai lay on the table next to him, poking his head like a kitten, staring at Calabash Baby curiously.

"They have such a good relationship, they don't try to steal food!"

He Zhousheng was helpless: "Yes, not only do they not know how to snatch food, they also don't know how to snatch cat litter boxes."

Jiang Dai blinked, shook his head, and stared at the comics beside him.

Finally, when He Zhou picked up a pen and started preparing to draw, he saw comments falling from the sky.

[Pfft, seven people per grave?Are there any normal people in this comic?】

[It’s too hellish. If I came here and couldn’t stay for three days, I would go crazy.】

[Conservative, one day.】
